performance_engine: NautilusTrader 1.230.0 only through existing candidate-02 run_window architecture

first_week.selection_method: deterministic shuffle of eligible Monday weeks inside direct-data coverage after excluding every candidate-02 revealed week

research_basis.source: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures, arXiv:2607.09426v2
research_basis.use: motivates a synchronized 15-minute execution origin and first-ten-second flow split; no paper-return coefficient is used as a parameter

research_basis.source: Order Flows and Limit Order Book Resiliency on the Meso-Scale, arXiv:1708.02715
research_basis.use: motivates separating acceptance after liquidity withdrawal from failure after replenishment rather than treating imbalance alone as a signal

causal_question: At a synchronized quarter-hour execution burst, does first-ten-second aggressive flow consume the frozen prior 15-minute external boundary and gain completed-price acceptance, or does the remaining fifty seconds absorb the shock and rotate through the prior auction?

mutually_exclusive_modes.confirmation: opening minute closes outside the frozen auction with aligned completed-minute flow
mutually_exclusive_modes.invalidation: opening origin/extreme or boundary plus 0.10 ATR

mutually_exclusive_modes.confirmation: opening minute accepts outside and next completed close remains outside without strongly opposing flow
mutually_exclusive_modes.entry: market after second completed outside close
mutually_exclusive_modes.invalidation: opening origin/extreme or boundary plus 0.10 ATR

mutually_exclusive_modes.confirmation: opening minute accepts outside and a completed retest touches then holds the frozen boundary
mutually_exclusive_modes.invalidation: opening origin/extreme or boundary plus 0.10 ATR

mutually_exclusive_modes.confirmation: opening ten-second shock sweeps the frozen boundary but remaining fifty-second flow reverses and completed minute reclaims the auction

causality.first_ten_seconds: released only at containing minute close
causality.remaining_fifty_seconds: released only at containing minute close
causality.adaptive_thresholds: quarter-hour event-only rolling quantiles with shift(1)
causality.frozen_auction: the 15 completed one-minute bars immediately before the quarter-hour opening minute
causality.orders: submitted only at completed observation timestamps

fixed_risk.quantity_rule: current NautilusTrader account NAV times 3% divided by expected per-unit loss including entry and stop fees, slippage, impact and funding

promotion_rule: A mode must satisfy every first-week gate. A weak direction, frequency, reward geometry or drawdown ends that mode. Only a passing unchanged mode is locked before selecting and collecting a new second BTC week.
